en: A pioneer of Colombia’s early techno scene, Adriana Lopez has built a steady presence in Europe for the last two decades.

Her raw yet deep, progressive sound, produced and mixed with engineering precision, has reached the dark chambers of Berghain and Tresor and conquered labels like Semantica, Artefacts, and Modularz. Her sets prioritize flow on the dancefloor; her approach introduces consistency, skill, and dedication to pure techno.
sl: Adriana je dčva, ki je orala tehno ledino na kolumbijski sceni in pred dvajsetimi leti osvojila še evropsko celino. Svoj drugi dom si je na tti strani oceana porihtava v tmnih dvoranah Berghaina, njena produkcija pa je našla zavetje pri založbah tavlkega kova, tko je Semantica.
Z inženirsko preciznostjo in progresivnim skladanjem čistih in globokih soundov bo pleme prifurala skoz taglavni odsek endemitskega vnebohoda, brez da bi koga vrglo iz ritma na floro.

en: Alessio, our neighbour from Padova, has impressed us with his deeply emotional and melodic productions and his skill of melting genres that go beyond techno limits. As an ever-growing artist, he switched from releasing music on reputable labels to releasing his own albums, which explore everything between ambient and trance.
He is a true musician who spends most of his time in his studio experimenting with synthesizers, so catching his DJ performance is a rare blessing.
sl: Allesio je sosed iz Padove, ki se nam je vtisno v spomin s svojo emocionalno, melodično produkcijo in tstim redkim talentom mešanja žanrov, ki izzivajo meje tehna. Njegove izdaje te enkrat presenetijo z ambientalo, drugič s trance-om, zmerm pa z dodelanim konceptom in frišno vizijo umetnika z vlko začetnico. Ker ga je izven studijskih soban in bk od sintov bol tžko ujet ko pa endemitka na plesiščo, je Allesio za mešalko skor tko sončev mrk – enkratni pojav, kerga ne smeš zamudit.

en: Isabel is a Berlin-based DJ and producer from Venezuela, who developed her raw, hypnotic, percussive sound in Canada, experimenting and exploring the openness of Montreal’s underground scene. Her music is about combining abstract textures and deep rhythms to trigger feelings, create one-of-a-kind experiences and the drive.

With her own label, NYXII Records, and her debut EP on Ostgut Ton, Isabel is doing things her way, organically and with heart. Her rise isn’t about hype; it’s about the one track, one set, one night at a time.
sl: Isabel je venezuelska tehno princesa z berlinsko vižo, ki je svoj neizumetničen ritmični stil razvijava na odprti sceni Montreala. Njene stvaritve so kombinacija abstraktnih vzorcov in globokih udarcov, s kerimi zna potisnt človeka do roba emocij.

S svojo založbo NYXII Records in vinilno izdajo pri Ostgut Ton je v širnem podzmljo našva svoj prostor pod soncom, njen vzpon pa ni noben marketinški trik, ampak rezultat tega, da se zmerm da co - za vsak komad, vsak set, en vnebohod za drugmo.

en: A resident DJ at Channel Zero and co-founder of the Cosmic Sex collective, Jaša is not only an artist but also a music journalist who reviews promising releases and covert stars, relying on his keen ear and rich vocabulary.
His performances at Butik, Ment, and Libertas festival make him a natural choice to bring house, bass, and summer vibes to our Endemit day stage.
sl: Jaša je glasbeni novinar, sokurator Sonice, vodja ljubljanskega Cosmic Sex kolektiva z rezidenco v klubo Channel Zero, s kerim bomo prekrižali poti za dnevno varjanto vnebohoda, ko si bo pleme zalizavo rane z miksom plesnih žanrov. Kot izkušen perfomer na Butiko in Mento je Jaša točno tsti del sestavlanke, ki bo dopovno festivalsko sliko s poletnim vajbom.

en: Material Object is a master of sonic architecture, based on abstract techno, ambient and psychedelic components that construct a multidimensional atmosphere. He has evolved his style through collabs with pioneers like Pete Namlook, gaining recognition by worldwide audiences and labels.

After years of bringing his distinct sound to venues like Berghain and Labyrinth festival, he settled in Slovenia and has agreed to enlighten the Carinthian forest with his ambient set for the second time.
sl: Andrew je naš mate iz Avstralije, ker ma že status seniorja v eksperimentiranjo z abstraktnimi in psihedeličnimi prvinami tehna. Skoz vse zvočne pore je začno potovat že ko froc, ki je zraso gr na konco svta in nagrunto, da ga bo orginalni sound enkrat poplo okrog oble. Tk ga je po letih produceranja in live-performansov po vseh tavlkih klubih in festivalih zanesvo v našo podalpsko deželo, kjer je sposto nove korenine in bo že drugič s svojo ambientalo razsvtlo koroško šumo.

en: After testing b2b combinations of our Endemit artists, the OG team returns for another closing that will rewrite history. MMali and Rhageal are like day and night, one known for his progressive exploration of percussive and melodic genres, the other for mining the deepest and rare techno matter. Matej and Bobi, both experts in improvisation and strangers to mundane performances, will challenge the worldview of the masses and absolve all non-virgin Marys in the final act of the ascent.
A referendum on this year’s b2b choice is unconstitutional — their music hits deep and is taxing on the body.
sl: Po testiranjo endemitskih b2b kombinacij je padva komanda, da morta z novim zgodovinskim setom vnebohod spt zaklučit orginalna gangstrja z Ravn in Šoštanja. Matej pa Bobi sta tko dan pa noč - taprvi s svojimi melodijami, basi in pisanimi žanri najbol zasije za froštik, tadrug pa najrajš v nočni smeni rudari za redkimi kovinami v najglobljih rovih. Kr improvizacija nobenmo ni španska vas in nas še nikol nista postva na cedilo, sta bva izbrana, da preverita trdnost plemena in odrešita vse Marije pocestniških grehov.
Referendum na letošnjo izbiro dvojic je protiustavn — njun closing je temelj endemitskega prava, davk na telo pa skladn s fiskalnimi pravili.

en: Beko is bringing reinforcements from Zagreb, confronting his exchange of deep and raw grooves with Mozer’s minimal structures and hypnotic sounds.

Both pioneers of the Croatian underground scene display technical skills and sheer focus – Beko mixing with a fine-tuned progressive touch, allowing Mozer to join in with emotive genres, including deep house or electro.
sl: Beko bo letos prplo okrepitve iz Zagreba in soočo svoje progresivne note z Mozerjevim minimalizmom in hipnozo. Brata Hrvata sta oba starešini zagrebškega podzemlja, Mozer pa se je na elektronski sceni rolo še predn smo mi odkrili dvorano Rog. Hrbet si bota kriva že prvo noč endemitskega vnebohoda, ko bota pleme popelava skoz svoj ritmični, napet odsek vzpona.

en: Obscur is our Endemit prodigy, who is steadily building a name in Europe as an artist. His sound is mature and refined, his productions deep, driving, and subtly psychedelic, each track showcasing his relentless pursuit of innovation. Tim's commitment to authenticity and the essence of techno have been recognized by respected labels such as Modularz, Paralelo, Newrhythmic, and Moving Pressure.

As a DJ, he approaches each set with the same level of precision, placing layers upon layers of raw and hypnotic sound to create tension and atmosphere. Whether in the studio or behind the decks, his focus is clear — to let the music speak for itself.
sl: Obscur je endemitska zvezda, kera vse bol sveti na vseh straneh neba naše celine. Tim je s svojim soundom dorasto kundije in s produciranjem progresivnih, psihedelično začinjenih komadov izkazo jekleno volo pri iskanjo novih zvočnih dimenzij, kar so opazli tut pri založbah Modularz, Paralelo in Moving Pressure.
Njegovo umetniško rast nismo mogli spregledat niti pri letošnjem razporejanjo odsekov našega vnebohoda, zato bo dobo eno od častnih zaklučnih pozicij.

en: Rahul is the youngest member of the Endemit collective, a tireless exemplar of dedication to our common cause. His sets reflect his oriental roots and create a vivid journey of themes, sounds, and genres discovered on the way from Baku to Berlin. His second visionary family is RÆHAT, which runs an exciting new underground venue on the Slovenian coast.
Rahul’s Endemit speciality is a warm-up set, a heartfelt encounter with his creative mind, which invites the listener to share the depth and passion that define everything he does.
sl: Rahul je najmlajši in najbol lojaln član endemitske familije, ki se je prpravlen obrnit na glavo za vsak skupn cilj. Za mešalko tžko prikrije svoje orientalske korenine, ker tam zmerm koplje po motivih, soundih in žanrih, ki si jih je shrano na poti od Bakuja do Berlina.

S svojo drugo familijo RÆHAT, ki je sicr njegova prva, ma čez tmna skladišča slovenskega pristanišča, ko je v endemitskem skrbništvo pa se zmerm izkaže s kreativnimi seti, skoz kere nam pove, na ka vse študera pa kk rad nas ma pa cev svt okol sbe.

en: The Dragon of Šoštanj, Rhaegal, is one of the few local artists who not only masters the art of flawless mixing but also boasts a strong production background and runs his own label, Hands of the Creator. While it may seem that he mines only in the darkest corners of the independent electronic scene, a ray of melody shines through his sets just at the right moment—before an unforgiving rhythm plunges you into the depths of yet undiscovered shades of techno.
sl: Šoštanski zmaj Rhaegal je edn redkih avtohtonih artistov, ki se poleg brezhibnega zlaganja soundov lahko pohvali tut z močno produkcijo, kero izdaja prek svoje založbe Hands of the Creator. Čeprav se kermo kda zazdi, da Bobs rudari sam po najtemnejših rovih neodvisne elektronske scene, v njegovih setih žarek melodije posije ravno v tapravem momento, predn da ga spt naloži z ritmom in se potopi nazaj v brezno neodkritih odtenkov tehna.

en: Vermisst is a shadowy enigma in the Slovenian electronic music realm, known for his atmospheric productions that explore the boundaries of ambient and techno. His releases on labels like Hypnus blend hypnotic rhythms with immersive textures.
As a performer, he brings order to the chaos of unimaginable sounds, positioning himself as a unique and powerful voice in the underground electronic scene.
sl: Vermisst je definicija nove generacije umetnikov z jasno kreativno špuro, kera seka čez ambientalo do globin tehna in zmerm najde težišče v kaoso ritmično melodičnih vzorcov. Teo bo s svojim setom segrev atmosfero na tazadni večer in na stržaj ofno vrata v vesolje endemitskim vnebohodnikom.

en.title: Camping
paragraphs:
The festival is best experienced in a community setting by camping within the festival grounds 
🏕 (All tickets include camping by default).

en.title: Hotels & apartments
paragraphs: Hotel accommodation is available in limited capacities at Hotel Korošica ★★★★. If you hurry, you may also find an apartment nearby on Google, Booking or other sites.

en.title: Camper vans
paragraphs: If you're staying with a camper van, there are 6 municipality spots available at the entrance to the festival grounds with utility connectors for a nominal fee.

sl.title: Kampiranje
paragraphs:
Festival se najlepš doživi skop s kolegi med plemenom — s šotorom na travniko, kerga že vsi dobro poznamo
🏕 (šotorjenje je možno za vse, da se spočijete pa streznite po tžki noči).

sl.title: Hoteli & apartmaji
paragraphs: Hotelska nastanitev je na volo v Hotelo Korošica. Če pohilaš, najdeš morda tut kak apartma v bližini.

sl.title: Avtodomi & vani
paragraphs: Če se prpeleš z avtodomom al pa kombijom, je na parkiriščo na volo 6 občinskih mest s prklopom na komunalo za simbolično ceno.

en.title: Food
paragraphs: As the food from last year left a good taste in our mouths and no leftovers on trays, we will again leave the menu in the hands of our host, the Sajevec family. This year the Carinthian fusion cuisine will feature our traditional burger, tacos with local beef and vegetarian spring rolls filled with buckwheat. Fries will address vegan and any other dietary concerns.
For breakfast, the eggs will be served inside an English muffin, in American pancakes, or in a local dessert – one we cannot translate, but you must try.
All food will be solely payable by using the digital Wallet.

en.title: Drinks
paragraphs: Two bars will be open during peak hours to rejuvenate all bodies and souls with fresh, spirited, or light drinks. Whether Kristjan and his team will give your wooziness a pass like last time depends entirely on your attitude.
All drinks will be solely payable by using the digital Wallet.

sl.title: Hrana
paragraphs: Kr se je lani futr lpo obneso tko na brbončicah kot na praznih talerih v smetjo, bomo tut letos nadaljevali s koroško fuzijo familije Sajevec. Poleg tradicionalnega burgerja bojo na dnevnem menijo tacosi iz domače krave in vegi spomladanski zavitki z ajdo, tsto domačo žitarico kero skoz pozabiš skuhat namesto krompira – ki je sicr nepogrešljiv dev njive na požiralniko in bo tk spt ocvrta opcija za vegane .
Za froštik bojo letos jajca v angleškem mafino al pa ameriških palačinkah, gazda pa bo mev perajt še koroški tomerli, da nev kermo po dovgi noči cukr pado.
Vsa hrana bo plačljiva izključno z digitalno Denarnco.

sl.title: Pijača
paragraphs: Revitalizacija s hladnimi, šarf in nežnimi zapitki bo spt možna na dveh šankih, na kerih te bo postrego Kristjan z ekipo, al se bojo tut letos pretvarjali, da se ga nisi orngi prbiv, pa je odvisno od tbe in tvojga odnosa.
Vsa pijača bo plačljiva izključno z digitalno Denarnco.

en: Our festival grounds sit in Libeliče, on the Slovenian-Austrian border, where the Drava runs past meadows and old forest. Nature does the heavy lifting here — we just bring the sound.
The basics are covered: clean toilets, warm showers, proper food, cold drinks and shelter when the rain comes. You don't have to think about any of it.

For years, this has been our cornerstone, our sacred ground for summer gatherings. Here, beneath open skies and canopies of trees, we dissolve into one another and the music, losing track of time as the Drava whispers alongside our collective rhythm. It's where the dancefloor meets the earth, where friendships deepen, and where the boundaries between self and surroundings blur into something beautifully undefined.
This is where we return, season after season, to remember what matters.
sl: Naš plac leži v Libeličah, blizo slovensko-avstrijske meje, kjer Drava teče mimo travnikov in stare koroške šume. Narava tole opraji glavno delo — mi prnesemo sam lučke, dekoracijo in zvok.
Osnove so pokrite: čista stranišča, tople prhe, prava hrana, mrzla pijača in streha, ko pride dež. Na nič od tega ti ni treba mislit.

Že leta je to naš temelj, naša sveta zemlja za poletno techno mašo. Tu, pod odprtim nebom in krošnjami dreves, se razpustimo drug v drugega in v glasbo ter izgubimo občutek za čas, medtem ko Drava šepeta ob našem kolektivnem ritmu. Tu se plesišče sreča z zemljo, kjer se prijateljstva poglobijo in kjer se meje med seboj in okolico zabrišejo v nekaj čudovito nedoločenega.
Sem se vračamo, sezono za sezono, da se spomnimo, kaj je pomembno.
